dek: Hong Kong Customs yesterday (August 6) detected a drug trafficking case involving baggage concealment at Hong Kong International Airport. About 6 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of about $1.2 million were seized. A 46-year-old Mainland male passenger arrived in Hong Kong from Bangkok
